messages.content: Ann is older than Bob. Bob is older than Cy. Who is the youngest? Answer with one name.

grammar.text:
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
root ::= "{" space youngest-kv space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
string ::= "\"" char* "\""
youngest-kv ::= "\"youngest\"" space ":" space string
